name: Chromite Bridge
description: Forward Telegram DMs (and /chromite commands) to local chromite-server /v1/chat/stream for AI-commerce agent loop.

chromiteUrl.description: chromite-server base URL. Falls back to env CHROMITE_BRIDGE_URL.

maxReplyChars.description: Truncate final reply (Telegram 4096-char hard limit minus margin).

requestTimeoutMs.description: Max ms to keep SSE connection alive before aborting.
